semi-log-plots-line.alt: Semi-log plot of bacteria, in thousands, against hours: the points (0, 3) through (6, 192) for y = 3 times 2 to the t lie on a straight line.

semi-log-plots-set1.alt: Semi-log plot of app users against years since 2016: five points on a straight line, with A at (0, 20), B at (4, 200) and C at (8, 2,000).

semi-log-plots-compare.alt: Two plots of the same data, y = 3 times 2 to the t for t = 0 to 6 hours. On ordinary axes from 0 to 200 the points make a concave up curve with the early points crowded near the axis. On a semi-log plot, with 1, 10, 100 and 1,000 equally spaced, the same points lie on a straight line from (0, 3) to (6, 192).
